reason: The closest published SEPNET benchmark uses fixed non-overlapping 24-hour predictor windows and explicitly notes that one physical SEP event can create multiple positive prediction windows when it persists longer than 24 hours. This clarification separates repeated-window weighting from persistence-state exclusion instead of collapsing both mechanisms into one contrast.

mechanism_contrasts.direct_proton_history: PROTON_STATE_BLIND_ONSET versus otherwise-identical proton-aware onset model
mechanism_contrasts.persistence_probability_shift: proton-aware versus proton-blind probabilities/alerts on ALREADY_ACTIVE_PERSISTENCE rows

occurrence_episode_mapping.positive_window_mapping: map each occurrence-positive prediction window to operational threshold episodes whose active interval overlaps the 24-hour prediction window

model_training_protocol.purpose: freeze prediction files first, then rescore identical probabilities under all compatible evaluation views

models.xgboost_proton_blind: same XGBoost specification with direct proton-history feature family removed

A_published_SEPNET_data_audit.goal: independently quantify operational-positive window multiplicity, persistence share, episode mapping, and target-construction reconciliation on the authors' pinned public rolling/event tables
A_published_SEPNET_data_audit.claim: published-data audit only; no claim that the paper's reported SEPVAL test score is biased unless the exact published test evaluation is reproduced

B_IRIS_GOES_exposed_mechanism_replay.goal: train fixed simple models on the already-exposed 2011-2017 GOES-13 proton + GOES-15 XRS development archive and measure the frozen mechanism contrasts with complete prediction-level evidence

H3_directional_interpretation: The original preregistered H3 remains part of the record. In addition, report the proton-aware minus proton-blind effect separately for onset and persistence without choosing a favorable direction post hoc.
